review:
A cheerful tramp digging through doughnuts, cans, pizza and – with luck – cash, on a 6x5 pay-anywhere grid with refills.

Random multipliers land in the base game as well as free spins, so ordinary spins have more upside than in Bonanza Billion. Very high volatility, a 5,000x max and an excellent 97.17% RTP. Free spins about once every 163 spins – more often than most Bonanza games.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
